svg.aria-label: A process has its own address space with code, heap and stack; separate processes cannot see each other's memory. Threads inside one process share the code and heap but each has its own stack and registers.

svg.text: One process, three threads: shared heap
cheap to share data · a bug in one can corrupt all
talk only via pipes, sockets, shared files
